9:512

The number given on the left side is reduced by 1 and then take the cube of that number is equal to the number given on right side.

So

9 - 1 = 8 ; 83 = 512.

Similarly,

4 - 1 = 3 ; 33 = 27.

Hence the correct answer is '4:27'.

questions.q_en:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set:

(12, 7, 42)

(33, 4, 66)
questions.solution_en:
The third number is half of the product of the first number and the middle number:

(1/2) x (12 x 7) = 84/2 = 42.

(1/2) x (33 x 4) = 132/2 = 66.

Similarly,

(1/2) x (9 x 12) = 108/2 = 54.

Hence the correct answer is '( 9, 12, 54)'.
